relations: Kayla 与 Ares：受雇在 Ares 的酒吧上一班（临时工），随后成为恋人，“Ares asked me if I could work a shift at his bar this week, and I agreed because it just so happened to fall on my night off.” / “He moves, fucking me against the door, and I am unable to think about anything else.”
Kayla 与 Ares：立下不可破的边界，Ares 口头承诺「“No manipulation,” he says.」
Kayla 与 Clay：她把不安发给 Clay，Clay 夜里出现在她公寓守着她，「Clay smirks from his seat at my dining table. “I have my ways.”」
Kayla 与 Vero/Nixie：酒吧同事，Vero 向她讨吻、Nixie 是管束他的管理者，「He sighs and leans in, pressing a kiss to my lips.」
Kayla 与 Cave：Cave 用谜语给她一个「影子」的答案并随即离开，「The answer is a shadow, but why would he be giving me that riddle?」
numbers: You have been here a few times now
Ares is quiet for a second

facts.fact: Cave 走进 Ares 的酒吧，给 Kayla 留下一整段谜语后立刻离开，谜底指向影子
facts.anchor: I wear the shape of everything but have no shape of my own. I follow without being invited and leave without being asked. I am closest to you when your back is turned, and I vanish the moment you face me. I have been here longer than you know.

facts.fact: Kayla 收店时再次产生被观察的感觉，站到门口盯着巷子里进出礼物店的人
facts.anchor: I stand in the doorway and look out into the alley, peering at the people still going in and out of the gift shop.

facts.fact: Ares 从背后走近吓到 Kayla，她撞到东西、手中的杯子泼出液体
facts.anchor: I spin and my elbow connects with something solid. The glass in my hand tips, and cold liquid runs down my wrist and drips to the floor between us.

facts.fact: 在储藏室里 Kayla 先立下不可破的底线：若 Ares 拿她刚坦白的过去换东西，她会走且不回头，Ares 答应不做操纵
facts.anchor: if you use this to get something from me, I will walk away and won’t come back. That is a rule you cannot break.

facts.fact: 两人在储藏室发生关系
facts.anchor: He moves, fucking me against the door, and I am unable to think about anything else.

facts.fact: Ares 骑车送 Kayla 回阁楼并叮嘱她锁好门窗，Kayla 嘴硬回他一句「Yes, Dad」
facts.anchor: “Make sure you lock your door and windows.”

facts.fact: Kayla 睡前给 Clay 发消息，说只是想让有人知道自己的不安
facts.anchor: I know it’s late, but the feeling is back. I just wanted someone to know.

facts.fact: Clay 未被邀请已坐在 Kayla 公寓的餐桌旁，Kayla 最终让他上床一起睡
facts.anchor: Clay smirks from his seat at my dining table. “I have my ways.”
